name: Peníscola (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Peñíscola (a castle between fleurs-de-lis on a rock above waves on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Peníscola; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Peñíscola arms — castle between fleurs-de-lis on a rock above waves
